description: Edge short form with only direction and types.

age.statement: SELECT * FROM cypher('age_graph', $$ MATCH (p:Person)-[:KNOWS]->(f:Person) RETURN p.name $$) AS (name agtype)

sql_pgq.statement: SELECT * FROM GRAPH_TABLE (graph_table MATCH (p IS "Person") -[ IS "KNOWS"]-> (f IS "Person") COLUMNS (p.name))
